# EMMana-Next rev29 — simple optimizer goals

- Main optimizer UI now exposes three user goals: Balance, Best matching, Maximum gain.
- Frequency range moved into the simple optimizer block.
- Algorithm, population, generations, weights, robustness and manufacturing controls remain under Technical details.
- Goal selection writes explicit existing optimizer weights/limits; backend API and optimizer semantics are unchanged.
- Manual advanced edits are preserved and clearly marked as custom technical tuning.
- Added Russian optimizer help and clearer user-facing optimizer status/errors.
- Solver physics, EMNX schema, measurement contract and optimization backend are unchanged.
